channel.title: GNUS digest
channel.description: Daily digest of the GeniusVentures GitHub activity, written from public commit messages.

item.title: GNUS digest — Friday 27 November
item.description: The blockchain network added regression tests for malformed block parameters and improved database retry logic. The SDK now rejects a second instance using the same data directory and reads job data fully. The processing manager added validation for block parameters on the job‑cost path. Repositories: SuperGenius, GeniusSDK, SGProcessingManager, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Thursday 26 November
item.description: The wallet incorporated shared AI rules from the development agent. The AI system adjusted its multinode tests to use the loopback address. Repositories: GeniusWallet, GeniusCognitiveSystem, rlp_enodes.

item.title: GNUS digest — Wednesday 25 November
item.description: The blockchain network introduced security threat verification, cleaned up old requirement files and archived milestone data. The AI system switched all build pipelines to self‑hosted runners and merged related updates. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, GeniusCognitiveSystem.

item.title: GNUS digest — Tuesday 24 November
item.description: The blockchain network applied several fixes and upgraded dispatch components, the AI system added a new architecture‑review skill and updated related documents, and the SDK refreshed generated model documentation. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-cpp-scaffolding, thirdparty.

item.title: GNUS digest — Monday 23 November
item.description: The blockchain network fixed build stubs and updated documentation, while the AI system added a test fix for MSVC/clang. An automated scaffold update was recorded for the SDK tools. Repositories: GeniusNetwork, SuperGenius, GeniusCognitiveSystem, openapi-client-scaffold.

item.title: GNUS digest — Sunday 22 November
item.description: The wallet fixed startup messages and disabled rename until the name actually changes, and added safeguards for the quiz and rename actions. The blockchain network fixed record cleanup, upgraded a network phase, and added tests to reproduce funding reservation leaks. Repositories: GeniusWallet, SuperGenius.
